title: Among Marvel Comics superheroes who are villains (alignment = 'Bad'), find
question: Among Marvel Comics superheroes who are villains (alignment = 'Bad'), find those who have more than 10 superpowers and rank them by their durability attribute value in descending order. Return their full names, number of superpowers, and durability rank.

prediction.sql:
WITH HeroPowers AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS HeroID,
        s.XCL_020 AS FullName,
        COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS PowerCount
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN alignment a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020
    HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 10
),
HeroDurability AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS HeroID,
        ha.XCL_011 AS DurabilityValue
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute at ON ha.XCL_010 = at.XCL_003
    WHERE at.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
)
SELECT 
    hp.FullName,
    hp.PowerCount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd.DurabilityValue DESC) AS DurabilityRank
FROM HeroPowers hp
INNER JOIN HeroDurability hd ON hp.HeroID = hd.HeroID
ORDER BY hd.DurabilityValue DESC

WITH HeroPowers AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS HeroID,
        s.XCL_020 AS FullName,
        COUNT(hp.XCL_013) AS PowerCount
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN alignment a ON s.XCL_027 = a.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN publisher p ON s.XCL_026 = p.XCL_014
    INNER JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
    WHERE a.XCL_002 = 'Bad'
      AND p.XCL_015 = 'Marvel Comics'
    GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_020
    HAVING COUNT(hp.XCL_013) > 10
),
HeroDurability AS (
    SELECT 
        s.XCL_018 AS HeroID,
        ha.XCL_011 AS DurabilityValue
    FROM superhero s
    INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
    INNER JOIN attribute at ON ha.XCL_010 = at.XCL_003
    WHERE at.XCL_004 = 'Durability'
)
SELECT 
    hp.FullName,
    hp.PowerCount,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY hd.DurabilityValue DESC) AS DurabilityRank
FROM HeroPowers hp
INNER JOIN HeroDurability hd ON hp.HeroID = hd.HeroID
ORDER BY hd.DurabilityValue DESC
